TEXT:
We went to a park by the sea to watch the sunset, 
but...
This is bad, I'm gonna die of embarrassment.

I didn't think it would be so embarrassing, just 
walking together while holding hands...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-What's wrong? Why are you suddenly squatting 
like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's nothing, I'm just... a little dizzy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I see. How about we rest on that bench for now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes... I'm fine. I'm okay now.

I looked up after letting out a breath of relief, the 
sun was in the midst of setting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's beautiful, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's times like these that I feel most blissful...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yeah.

If it's the two of us, we don't need to go to a stylish 
café or places normal couples go to. I bet she 
would say something like that.

As we're passing the time in silence, I realized 
something... Huh, don't we have a really good mood 
going right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: K-Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What is it?

Without answering, I started brushing her hair 
gently.

Kuroneko stiffened for a moment but she didn't 
resist. C-Could I... go for it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey. Can I... kiss you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: N-No!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, I-I thought so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
W-Wait... No... T-That's not it... I was just surprised by 
you asking so suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
W-With you, sometimes I cannot make light of 
whether you are being incompetent or forceful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: O-On the cheek...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Like I said, you can... um... on the cheek.
This is probably the best she can do right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I had a lot of fun today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You planned many different things for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
You accompanied me to the many places I wanted 
to go to...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, how was it for you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Did your heart experience as much joy as I did?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Did the soul of the black beast dwelling in your 
chest quiver?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Was I able to satisfy you, even with my cowardice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're not regretting receiving my curse, are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why would you say that?

It was fun and exciting. My girlfriend was cute 
today as well. That's why I can only reply to those 
questions with a question of my own.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
B-But you're with someone who still hasn't given 
you another curse (kiss) since we started dating, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're worried about that, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That? I am seriously asking you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I have fun just being with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I had a lot of fun today. So, we should go on 
another date someday.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Yes, I agree.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, but I do have one thing I am unsatisfied with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Wh-What would that be? Let's see, depending on 
what it is, I'm not reluctant to try and improve on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No, it's nothing serious. I was thinking you could call 
me by my name, instead of "senpai" from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: B-By... your name?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You know, we're dating, yet calling me senpai still is 
a bit disappointing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Y-You say that, but you call me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure? Okay then, I'll call you Ruri from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah---uh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Let's come here again sometime, R-Ruri...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...N-No, it's Kuroneko, please call me Kuroneko. My 
heart's not ready yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I understand... Well, shall we leave soon?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Let's stay a bit longer... Just for a while, I want to be 
with you, Senpa-... K-Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yeah, got it.

We took in the time together as the afterglow of 
the setting sun shone upon us.
